title: In Conversation: Vitalik Buterin & Siddharth Shetty
description: Vitalik Buterin and Siddharth Shetty have each built systems that serve millions of people, across very different sectors. They come together to compare what it takes to build for billions, and what those lessons reveal about the future of coordination.
